name: codex-tps-plus
description: Show Codex CLI delayed TTFT, request throughput including TTFT, and end-to-end turn throughput.

interface.shortDescription: Delayed TTFT plus request and whole-turn throughput for Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Shows delayed turn TTFT, model-request throughput including TTFT, and end-to-end turn throughput after Codex CLI responses; stores only redacted numeric session metrics and never labels unjoinable OTel TBT as current-turn TPS.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest Codex request throughput and session average.
Show the latest backfilled TTFT and explain its delayed timing.
